dataset_source: FieldMaps, U.S. Department of State, OpenStreetMap
methodology_other: Very high resolution boundaries using [OpenStreetMap](https://osmdata.openstreetmap.de/data/land-polygons.html) for coastline data, [U.S. Department of State Large Scale International Boundaries (LSIB)](https://hiu.state.gov/data/) for international boundaries, and [United Nations Department of Statistics M49](https://unstats.un.org/unsd/methodology/m49/overview/) for attributes. See [GitHub](https://github.com/fieldmaps/adm0-generator) for technical information on how this layer is made.
name: global-international-boundaries-osm
notes:
Original site: https://fieldmaps.io/data/adm0

International boundaries in two versions using US DoS LSIB for boundaries and OpenStreetMap for coastline data.

International: Balanced world view for use by international non-governmental organizations. Disputed areas follow recommended representation used by the UN Clear Map. UN agencies should use official layers at the UN Geospatial Hub.

All: Conservative world view that dissagregates all disputed areas. Useful if applying customized area aggregations.

organization.name: fieldmaps
organization.title: FieldMaps
organization.description: FieldMaps builds mobile, offline, interactive reference maps & globally aggregated datasets for humanitarian use. We leverage open source tools to automate the production of very high resolution outputs from a wide variety of sources. Our algorithm for edge extending allows us to create global edge-matched administrative boundaries updated frequently with new sources.

title: Global International Boundaries - OSM
